title: Layered Quantum Architecture Search for 3D Point Cloud Classification
summary: We introduce layered Quantum Architecture Search (layered-QAS), a strategy inspired by classical network morphism that designs Parametrised Quantum Circuit (PQC) architectures by progressively growing and adapting them. PQCs offer strong expressiveness with relatively few parameters, yet they lack standard architectural layers (e.g., convolution, attention) that encode inductive biases for a given learning task. To assess the effectiveness of our method, we focus on 3D point cloud classification as a challenging yet highly structured problem. Whereas prior work on this task has used PQCs…
